#  14130 - Impromptu designs, Workshops and Excursions Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **14130**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Impromptu designs, Workshops and Excursions**  |  
|  Stegreife, Workshops and Exkursionen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Lundqvist, Anna 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Impromptu Design and Workshop: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to find solutions to specific urban problems within a limited time frame and implement these in a design format. They will be able to identify key challenges and potentials, formulate design ideas, and develop them into spatial designs in a targeted and efficient manner. Excursion: Students will develop the ability to identify urban problems and potentials of a given site, evaluate the existing conditions, and critically analyse implemented projects. They will also gain the skill to prepare structured reports of their visit following academic formats.The module consists of three impromptu assignments/workshops/excursions, each of which should comprise a workload of 60 hours. The impromptu assignment/workshop should include the following elements: graphic representation of the idea, the spatial integration of the solution approach, the conceptual approach or the preliminary design, model (depending on the topic), scales (depending on the topic).  |  
| Contents:  | Impromptu Design and Workshop: Each impromptu or workshop should address one of the focal points of the Master Programme in Urban Design and Sustainable Revitalization. Students will be asked to critically analyze the site and propose design solutions depending on the workshop topic. Excursion: Each excursion includes a visit to a site or a project addressing one of the focal points of the Master Programme in Urban Design and Sustainable Revitalization. Students will be asked to conduct a preparatory task prior to the excursion, critically analyse the site during the excursion, and finally, prepare a well-structured report about their experience..   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Short term design project / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | will be announced by the lecturers   |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  In order for the module to be recognised, a total of three components; impromptu designs and/or workshops and/or excursions must be demonstrated and recognised. The weighting for the module grade is 1/3 each. A maximum of two componentsmay be taken in the same chair.Impromptu design/workshop: The work to be completed for each impromptu or workshop is determined by the respective lecturer at the beginning and may include in particular preparation of plans, construction of a model, written elaboration, presentation of the design or concept, structural realisation of an object, intervention in urban space. Excursion: Excursion report (content-related preparation and follow-up) (50%); active participation in the excursion including thematic contributions on site or as part of an accompanying seminar (presentation approx. 15 min) (50%).  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Architektur / keine PO 
  * Master (research-oriented) / Urban Design and Sustainable Revitalization / PO 2024 

 |  
| Remarks:  | In the event that the module cannot be taught or examined in accordance with this description (e.g. for reasons of infection control), the alternatives communicated on the relevant platforms (e.g. homepage or Moodle) apply.   |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Impromptu Design
  * Workshop
  * Excursion

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
